Reminders

Sign-on alerts need a secure (HTTPS) page and a browser that supports notifications. For a reminder that works on any phone, add your duties to the calendar.

Creates a calendar file with an alert before each sign-on, using the minutes above. Open it to add the duties to your phone’s calendar.

Privacy & backup

🔒 Your data stays on your device. Duties, incidents, pay details and your profile are saved only in this browser. There are no accounts, and nothing is uploaded or shared — not even with whoever hosts this app. (The only thing fetched from the internet is the font.)

This is an unofficial tool, not run by or connected to Dublin Bus or any union. Always check the depot board and your payslip for the real thing.

Moving to a new phone? Download a backup, send the file to yourself, then restore it on the new device.

Tip: iPhone Safari can clear saved data from sites you haven’t opened for about a week. Use Share → Add to Home Screen to keep it safe, and download a backup now and then.
